title: trackerClaudeTokenUsage
responsibility: Totals Claude transcript usage once per message and prices it at Tracker rung flat rates.

inputs.name: trackerClaudeTokenUsage.lines
inputs.description: JSON lines, each one Claude message id, model and usage.

outputs.name: trackerClaudeTokenUsage
outputs.description: Token totals and flat-rate cost, or nothing when no message has usage.
